Following an interim analysis of part one (Phase IIb) of the NAAVIGATE trial, we and AbbVie expect to initiate a Phase III expansion, including part two (Phase III) of the U.S.

In May 2026, we announced positive topline results from the pivotal Phase III AFFINITY DUCHENNE trial of RGX-202, including primary endpoint (n=30 at Week 12), interim safety (n=31) and interim functional data (n=9 at 12 months): • The primary endpoint was achieved with high statistical significance; 93% of patients achieved RGX-202 microdystrophin expression above 10% (p<0.0001).

As of May 2026, in recent discussions, the FDA shared that the use of RGX-202 microdystrophin expression as a surrogate endpoint will be based on the correlation analysis with clinical outcomes, which has been clearly demonstrated in our interim data.

Given the positive topline pivotal data, continued favorable safety profile, and statistically significant correlation between microdystrophin and functional improvement, we expect to hold a pre-Biologics License Application (BLA) meeting with the FDA in the fourth quarter of 2026 and submit a BLA in the first quarter of 2027 under the accelerated approval pathway, supporting potential FDA approval in the second half of 2027.

In August 2025, we announced that the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal date was extended from November 9, 2025 to February 8, 2026 following submission of 12-month clinical data for all patients in the pivotal study of RGX-121 (n=13) in response to an FDA information request.
These longer-term data were consistent with previously reported topline pivotal results from the CAMPSIITE trial.
Prior to that announcement, RGX-111 demonstrated to be well tolerated in interim results and indicated encouraging biomarker and neurodevelopmental results in a Phase I/II study.
